claims.claim: For fixed legal support, normalized categorical martingale innovation covariance is PSD, has constant-vector null mode, trace<=1-1/n and operator norm<=1/2, for arbitrary adapted conditional selection law and finite B. Scalar bounded mode variance <=range(f)^2/4. Actual per-selection R49 trace verified, including startup correction.
claims.limit: Normalized innovation only; no claim excluding critical behavior in drift, extensive observables, length or a singular joint limit. R49 per-selection conditional law, not all first four IID.

claims.claim: A noninteracting categorical model with one score gap exhibits exact sigmoid collapse in beta*Delta-log(n-1), and a finite Gibbs concentration bound follows from score range. Actual finite-size score landscapes and declared log-size control tested separately from adaptive dynamics.
claims.limit: Explicit counterexample to sufficiency of collapse as evidence of spatial criticality; not proof that all actual MCTS concentration is explained by this null. No physical temperature or scaling exponent.

claims.claim: Native adaptive MCTS has a controlled spatial critical limit with consistent finite-size scaling and identified RG fixed point.
claims.limit: Registered finite-size critical admission not established unless all predeclared comparisons pass; even a pass is descriptive and requires independent asymptotic mechanism. R76/R77 negative results and nonlumpability retained. No repeating same grid without new mechanism.
